findings.message: Proposed end-of-life 2027-04-16 exceeds 3-month cap required for upstream-sourced rocks without accepted support plan. App part builds from canonical/demo-rock (recipes/after/rockcraft.yaml:19–21). Reduce EOL to 2027-01-16 or obtain explicit CODEOWNERS approval of a support plan.

summary: Source version and tag bump from 1.2.0 to 1.2.1 (patch update); no parts, services, or build/stage packages changed. EOL extended by 3 months beyond policy cap, blocking approval pending support plan documentation.
